I've improved the score parsing logic to better handle the case when a valid response like "8,8,9,7" is received. The changes include:

1. Added detailed debug logging to help diagnose mismatches between document count and score count
2. Improved the fallback parsing by comparing which method (comma-separated vs. space-separated) provides scores closer to the expected count
